summary: DRA_DOWNSIDE_SEMIVARIANCE_BRANCH_CLOSE. The exact 52,608-row pre-2025 sealed H1 corpus, feature-specific primary prior, frozen declarative runner, unchanged DRA V1 parent parity, decision-time accounting and equal-capital assumptions passed. The primary 1.0 admission improved Design total PnL from 90.77797326 to 117.62466925 USDT, but realized PnL fell and the apparent uplift was carried by less-negative terminal inventory while drawdown and median holding worsened. It failed to generalize: historical Validation total PnL fell from 86.20298186 to 83.05896960 USDT, realized PnL fell by the same 3.14401226 USDT, drawdown rose from 7.121498% to 8.608374%, median/P90 holding worsened from 182.5/1418.3h to 212.5/2366.3h, annual total-PnL breadth was 1/5, and the sole positive annual delta contributed 100% of positive uplift. Both frozen neighbors failed. This historical development feature family is closed without tuning, candidate creation or OOS access.

uncertainty: Historical Validation is post-hoc development evidence and not clean OOS; the study cannot establish independent alpha or a strategy candidate.
Hourly returns are coarser than tick or five-minute realized-semivariance estimators, but changing sampling after the result is forbidden.
The Design total-PnL uplift was dominated by terminal inventory valuation while realized PnL fell, so it cannot be interpreted as independent economic support.
No post-2024, prospective, SHADOW, PAPER or LIVE evidence was opened or created.
recommended_next_action: Close and deduplicate the exact downside-semivariance-share DRA entry-admission family without threshold, lookback, sampling, sign or interaction rescue. Reuse the new direct-screen package builder for the next causally distinct mechanism only after it has a pre-outcome primary prior, decision-time feature, equal-capital comparator and direct runner; keep volume and range reserved for their existing prospective discovery contract.
